title: REQ · Scene focuses the object matching the store focusedObjectId
summary: Store focus value highlights the matching scene object
description: Context: BootScene.onStateChange only syncs objects with GameState. Desired behavior: on each store change it reads focusedObjectId and calls focus() on the SceneObject whose spec.id equals it. Expected result: that object shows the hover highlight and label. Why: store-driven focus must reach the canvas.
acceptance_criteria: Given focusedObjectId 'bookshelf' and a SceneObject with spec.id 'bookshelf' when the store notifies then that object's focus() is called
Given focusedObjectId names a different object then the 'bookshelf' object's focus() is not called
definition_of_done: BootScene focuses the matching object on store change
